verdict.rationale: Alacritty's own README says it deliberately leaves tabs and splits to a terminal multiplexer, and hands-on users report running tmux inside it, including tmux shortcuts working without any extra configuration. One WSL2 user could not get a few specific key combos working with tmux, but another reports all tmux shortcuts working, so this reads as a keybinding edge case, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation on tmux usage or configuration, any native tmux integration/control mode, consistent evidence that all tmux key combinations work across platforms.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use tmux inside the terminal, or a documented native tmux integration/control mode

citations.quote: This means you won't find things like tabs or splits (which are best left to a window manager or terminal multiplexer)
on Ubuntu with tmux and fish, Ctrl+A works and all tmux/fish shortcuts, including custom tab-like Ctrl bindings, worked without any Alacritty configuration.
The lack of scrollback and tabs doesn't bother them because they use tmux for that.
